items.description: The report gives no concrete numeric bound or formula for the undistributed fee or the inflated amountIn; only PoC example values are mentioned, so the amount-level relation cannot be quantified.
The report does not state whether the swap that counts the accrued fee is the immediate next transaction or merely the next call to the contract.
The report does not state whether the same-block calls and the subsequent swap are performed by the same or different actors.
